purpose: Fourth pass: source-grounded mathematical morphology and generator acceptance checks, rather than padding the catalog with new family IDs.
authority: _question_structure/QUESTION_STRUCTURE_CORE.md; catalogs/math_question_family_registry.json and specialist family files; variations governed by guides/parallel_family_rules.md and guides/math_family_quality.md.
source_use_rule: Structure and mathematical skill study only. Do NOT copy non-CPM source prompts, numbers, copyrighted pictures, answer choices, keys or exact problems into generated items. CPM R&P originals have their own explicit source-fidelity requirement.

focus: reviewed question examples with representation demands
limitations: Recipes are our original extrapolations from source structures, not claims that those exact three morphologies appear in source
Not a page-by-page audit of the whole source collection
Exact CPM lesson and I-can alignment is pending, not presumed
No student-ready problem or key is produced
Source text extraction may lose mathematical superscripts; avoid reproducing directly
Some source examples inspected visually from previous conversation files, others by bounded text extraction

recipes.focus: Open-number-line decimal strategy
recipes.student_action: Construct a jump strategy and compute a decimal result
task_morphologies: draw unknown forward jumps for addition
semantic_invariants: student must supply strategy not receive completed arcs

level_progression.3: select efficient strategy and defend equivalence

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Verify arcs sum to the actual signed change, labels match and no model pre-reveals a student-produced answer.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Copy a completed answer-key number line into the student prompt.

recipes.focus: Bidirectional double-number-line ratio
recipes.student_action: Recover a missing proportional quantity from two synchronized scales
task_morphologies: recover the original unit rate from a non-unit pair
semantic_invariants: paired ticks mean simultaneous equivalent quantities

level_progression.3: reason backward from an unfamiliar total

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Check every paired tick and conversion ratio; incomplete student line never includes the desired label.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Change only a person or enlarge the two given numbers without changing reasoning.

recipes.focus: Balance model to equation and back
recipes.student_action: Infer unknown mass/quantity from an actually balanced model
task_morphologies: write an equation from signed/unsigned blocks
construct a balance diagram from a provided equation

level_progression.2: multiple identical unknown objects and known blocks
level_progression.3: balanced after valid symmetric removal

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Calculate mass left/right; verify every model renders identical scale per unit and hides unknown count.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Describe a fake balance without rendering its actual diagram.

recipes.focus: Compare two rules with a constant offset
recipes.student_action: Complete two function tables and characterize their relation
semantic_invariants: same input must lead to consistent outputs

level_progression.2: rule inferred from two non-adjacent rows
level_progression.3: compare why two patterns differ by constant despite different starting point

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Independently evaluate all table rows and solve reverse input, using variables naturally.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Call repeated arithmetic with no dependent conclusion an extension.

recipes.focus: Scale factor despite changes of orientation
recipes.student_action: Identify corresponding sides and find directional scale factor

level_progression.3: reverse scale and check all sides

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Verify figure geometry/side ratios programmatically; all corresponding vertex labels accurate.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Use wrong side correspondence or let drawing proportions contradict labels.

recipes.focus: Complete—not inspect—a partial dilation
recipes.student_action: Construct the missing vertices of a scaled copy
task_morphologies: given a center plus one original vertex
semantic_invariants: answer image absent from student surface

level_progression.3: fractional scale about given center

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Compute mapped points, use registered graph tool, keep student image unplotted except stated givens.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Display the complete solution figure on the student graph.

recipes.focus: One or more ratio tables: decide what is valid
recipes.student_action: Identify whether every row preserves the unit ratio

level_progression.3: choose between two nearly plausible table patterns

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Recompute all cross products and ensure exactly intended tables/rows qualify.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Let two answer choices both satisfy the ratio accidentally.

recipes.focus: Scale drawing to a secondary consequence
recipes.student_action: Find a real-world distance or time using the printed drawing and rate
task_morphologies: drawing distance then time at given speed

level_progression.3: two-step route with a needed travel-rate conversion

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Verify ruler/drawing proportions, round only when instructed, and keep the second stage dependent on first.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Ask travel time while leaving the travel rate or distance ambiguous.

recipes.focus: Graph a change-of-rate story, not just a line
recipes.student_action: Construct a piecewise linear graph from successive intervals
task_morphologies: interpret an incomplete graph and finish last interval
semantic_invariants: end of stage i equals start of stage i+1

level_progression.3: infer missing interval rate from final total then graph

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Build coordinate vertex list independently and check stage times/levels; use graph tool and answer-neutral blank axes.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Supply the completed plot or inconsistent time intervals.

recipes.focus: Reverse direction from linear table to rule
recipes.student_action: Write a function equation using a table with nonconsecutive inputs
task_morphologies: rule to partial table for matching
semantic_invariants: the same ordered pairs define one linear function

level_progression.3: infer slope and intercept when neither is directly shown

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Compute m from independent pairs and verify each table cell; avoid showing completed equation in prompt.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Change only x,y labels while leaving the evidence identical.

recipes.focus: Interpret slope across two representation types
recipes.student_action: Compare a line slope with a rate encoded in a table
task_morphologies: derive slope from two distant points
compare slope magnitudes between graph and table

level_progression.3: compare rates including horizontal/vertical exception

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Use graph tool; slope equals rise/run; vertical slopes produce undefined, not numeric zero.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Treat undefined slope as zero or accept graph text with no actual plot.

recipes.focus: Make model interpretation distinct from arithmetic
recipes.student_action: Interpret a model point or coefficient using quantities and units
task_morphologies: interpret graph point in a story
create a suitable story for fixed slope/intercept

level_progression.2: rate and initial amount in context
level_progression.3: compare two models differing only in initial amount or rate

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Check dimensional units and context plausibility; response must distinguish amount from rate.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Ask for an unsupported interpretation or use a decorative narrative that changes nothing.

recipes.focus: Simplify before choosing an exponent property
recipes.student_action: Simplify expression and identify applicable exponent property
task_morphologies: evaluate property choice after one simplification
semantic_invariants: actual product/quotient/power law aligns with expression

level_progression.3: combine coefficient and two bases without added explanation burden

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Symbolically simplify independently and audit five property options (one correct under intended simplification).
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Make a new family just by appending explain or justify; show exponent 1 needlessly.

recipes.focus: Withhold equation when the student must write it
recipes.student_action: Extract quantities from context, write equation and solve unknown
task_morphologies: compare two pricing models when demanded by target
semantic_invariants: story supplies enough data and units

level_progression.3: compare thresholds using two linear models

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Check that question is uniquely answerable and computed unit count is meaningful, nonnegative and integral when count.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Prompt says write an equation but prints the equation or reveals purchased quantity.

recipes.focus: Actual generic rectangle as area evidence
recipes.student_action: Fill missing partial products then determine whole area
semantic_invariants: each interior area equals row times column

level_progression.2: mixed signs and full four cells
level_progression.3: given some product cells infer missing factor

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Recompute every cell and area sum; student cells are tall, blank and not answer-lined.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Render decorative rectangle with incorrect products or blank lines inside tight cells.

recipes.focus: Preserve function notation through every parallel
recipes.student_action: Evaluate named functions at provided inputs without losing f/g names
task_morphologies: two named functions with multiple inputs
semantic_invariants: input substituted in same function definition
meaningful_variation_axes: function types only when same lesson permits

level_progression.3: two functions and linked comparison

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Check every subpart and ensure notation survives; do not change source-original CPM R&P text except lawful numeric drafts.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Turn f(-3) into anonymous expression evaluation and claim it is the same evidence job.

recipes.focus: Orientation-invariant similarity evidence
recipes.student_action: Determine whether two differently oriented figures are similar
task_morphologies: infer common factor from two sides
explain why a proposed factor fails
semantic_invariants: shared angles and proportional corresponding sides

level_progression.3: test competing correspondences and reject false pairings

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Verify all side ratios, angles and any geometric labels; never infer shape from distorted drawing.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Use numerically similar sides on a picture with inconsistent angles.

recipes.focus: Student construction versus recognition
recipes.student_action: Construct image under specified transformations
semantic_invariants: each step applies to preceding image

level_progression.3: rotation plus non-unit dilation with traced vertices

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Independently compute each transformed coordinate, graph tool render of answer-neutral student grid.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Give complete transformed polygon on student graph or swap order of operations in key.

recipes.focus: Feasibility and counterexample—not only compute
recipes.student_action: Decide whether a claimed triangle arrangement is possible and justify
task_morphologies: construct counterexample to a universal claim
semantic_invariants: drawing does not falsely imply a relationship

level_progression.3: show why a tempting configuration violates invariant

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Use algebraic/geometry constraints to verify counterexample and all diagram markings.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Treat a longer calculation as proof, or invent nonstandard angle markers.

recipes.focus: Length vs area after scaling
recipes.student_action: Relate scale factor to changes in lengths and areas
task_morphologies: recover length factor from given area ratio
semantic_invariants: length scales k, area scales k^2

level_progression.3: area-to-length inference then area/perimeter comparison

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Check proportional sides and dimensions; explicitly separate linear from square units.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Apply factor k to both side and area or conflate visual shape with area ratio.

recipes.focus: Model constrained cubic volume from dimensions
recipes.student_action: Construct volume function from dimensions then locate meaningful extrema

level_progression.3: compare viable maxima with nonphysical algebraic roots excluded

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Substitute candidate h values, verify cubic algebra and feasible domain; separate numerical estimate from exact result.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Offer a mathematically critical point as acceptable when box has negative width.

recipes.focus: Construct different rational functions with same key features
recipes.student_action: Write rational functions satisfying constraints; compare uniqueness
task_morphologies: construct two functions meeting same asymptotes but different holes

level_progression.3: construct distinct valid functions with shared external behavior

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Factor numerators/denominators; independently check holes, asymptotes and excluded domain values.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Cancel a factor and forget its excluded input, or generate impossible feature combinations.

recipes.focus: Geometric sequence to exponential function and back
recipes.student_action: Find common ratio and explicit formula or reverse from a term
task_morphologies: given distant term infer initial amount

level_progression.3: infer ratio from nonconsecutive terms and estimate later value

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Check all displayed terms from generated formula, and compare n index consistently.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Quietly change n=0 to n=1 and leave exponent rule or key unchanged.

recipes.focus: Known factor as information, not an answer
recipes.student_action: Use a supplied polynomial factor to determine remaining factors/zeros
task_morphologies: check a claimed factor via remainder
semantic_invariants: given factor truly divides target in valid versions
meaningful_variation_axes: complex roots permitted only when intended

level_progression.3: compare claimed factors and identify one false claim

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Recompose factors and compare all coefficients exactly; check zero count with multiplicity.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Supply a non-factor in a prompt that presumes exact divisibility.

recipes.focus: Endpoint-sensitive piecewise construction
recipes.student_action: Graph piecewise function with correct inclusivity and discontinuity
task_morphologies: two interval rules split at boundary
complete graph from a partially plotted branch

level_progression.3: mixed linear/quadratic with boundary membership

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Evaluate each boundary from correct branch, and use graph tool with no completed answer curve in student view.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Draw open circle as filled or have two rules claim the same exclusive input.

recipes.focus: Function-feature dossier rather than compute everything
recipes.student_action: Determine selected rational features from equation or sketch
task_morphologies: reverse-write a function with specified features
match two different expressions to same graph
semantic_invariants: only one clear requested evidence job unless a linked chain

level_progression.3: recover numerator from two graph constraints

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Factor/limit check of every feature and graph-tool rendering; ensure hole marker visible when given.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Copy a mega-prompt asking seven unrelated features for a one-target quick check.

recipes.focus: Exact-value and inverse angle directions
recipes.student_action: Compute an exact trig value or identify an angle consistent with it

level_progression.3: inverse candidates on specified interval

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Evaluate against exact unit circle, confirm all permitted solutions in interval.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Return one solution for sin(theta)=value when two valid angles exist.

recipes.focus: Log rules as transformation with a reversible check
recipes.student_action: Transform a multi-term logarithm with valid domain constraints
task_morphologies: identify a false log splitting rule

level_progression.3: diagnose false log-of-sum using a counterexample

recipes.answer_and_visual_verification: Symbolically compare expanded/condensed expression on positive domain test points.
recipes.explicit_failure_to_avoid: Invent log(A+B)=log A+log B as a valid distractor without single correct answer.

qa_gates.condition: Every family ID is in the canonical registry collection; every instance matches allowed student action, modes and invariants.
qa_gates.fail_example: Family label says compare but prompt only computes a value.

qa_gates.condition: Required graph/table/model/diagram is physically rendered, not described vaguely in prose.
qa_gates.fail_example: Question mentions a graph but no axes or points are shown.

qa_gates.condition: Student view contains only givens; response surface does not supply requested equation, result, line or transformed image.
qa_gates.fail_example: Write an equation when equation is printed.

qa_gates.condition: Solve every instantiated variant afresh, then compare to official answer and worked steps.
qa_gates.fail_example: Two-sided linear coefficients cancel unexpectedly but key lists one solution.

qa_gates.condition: Known mathematical invariants of diagram match labels and givens; canonical graph tool used for Cartesian plots.
qa_gates.fail_example: Shape is visually plausible but tick marks or side lengths disagree.

qa_gates.condition: Same-level New Question keeps the same evidence job, response role, comparable operations and level.
qa_gates.fail_example: New Question converts function notation evaluation to anonymous arithmetic.

qa_gates.condition: Unknown and units specified; model gives intended number of solutions, not accidentally 0/infinitely many; choices have one justified answer when MC.
qa_gates.fail_example: A story asks how many items were purchased but number is already stated.

qa_gates.condition: R&P original has same multipart structure, function names, worked examples and source imagery; draft swaps stay within exact original task.
qa_gates.fail_example: Original six-part f/g task becomes evaluate anonymous expression.

qa_gates.condition: Area-model cells are blank and tall; grids/diagrams answer-neutral; content fits narrow columns and print without clipping.
qa_gates.fail_example: Answer blanks are printed as underlines inside small area cells.

qa_gates.condition: Third-party question resources used to study structures only; no source wording, exact problems, numerical instances, copyrighted diagrams or options copied into newly generated banks.
qa_gates.fail_example: Import a DeltaMath worksheet page as a CPM Direct Skills item.

qa_gates.condition: Track semantic dimensions—unknown, givens, representation, operation structure and misconception—independently of numeric count; a numerical-only set is appropriate only for explicit procedural fluency.
Three levels distinguish mathematical structure/necessary operations; awkward fractions or larger coefficients alone do not establish Level 3.
qa_gates.fail_example: A single one-step equation with a large denominator labeled advanced.

qa_gates.condition: Avoid 1x, x^1, gratuitous mixed numbers, unnatural coefficients and filler justify/explain unless reasoning is actually assessed.
qa_gates.fail_example: Adding justify creates a new family with otherwise identical evidence.

qa_gates.condition: Subparts share one meaningful stimulus or form a true dependency; do not add parts only to meet a count.
qa_gates.fail_example: Three unrelated problems labeled (a),(b),(c) and called multi-step.

qa_gates.condition: Extension needs a non-routine inference, construction, constraint, transfer or counterexample; never simply lengthen arithmetic.
qa_gates.fail_example: Extension is a more tedious copy of Level 3.

qa_gates.condition: Research ideas stay pending; original CPM, new original authored item, draft number-swap and approved generator specimen are labeled separately.
qa_gates.fail_example: Treat every researched source pattern as approved bank content.

cross_source_conclusions.application: Preserve a stable task contract for fluency variants; track how many semantic structures exist separately from how many numerical instances exist.

cross_source_conclusions.finding: Representation direction is part of mathematical evidence
cross_source_conclusions.application: Graph-to-equation, equation-to-graph and graph-to-verbal may be separate task morphologies only when student action and target support them.

cross_source_conclusions.finding: Multi-part is not the same as multi-step
cross_source_conclusions.application: Require shared meaningful stimulus or dependent inference, not arbitrary parts.

cross_source_conclusions.finding: Visual correctness takes precedence over polish
cross_source_conclusions.application: Use deterministic registered renderer and independently check mathematical geometry, endpoints, shading and answer neutrality.
Alternate unknown quantity or givens while preserving legal mathematical target and difficulty.

cross_source_conclusions.finding: Multi-version batch construction needs set-level diversity checks
cross_source_conclusions.application: Calculate distribution of structural types and reject near-duplicate runs before teacher sees them.

cross_source_conclusions.finding: A context earns its place only when its data changes reasoning
cross_source_conclusions.application: Use quantities/units/models meaningfully; otherwise prefer concise question.

chapter3_pilot_acceptance_cases.check: Check same skill across dot/parentheses/two expressions, varied exponents and correct property choice after actual simplification.
Original tile patterns intact, figures readable and any newly drawn rectangles mathematically equivalent.
All number-swapped versions preserve named function notation, each requested evaluation, and source multi-part structure.
Original explanatory example remains with the resulting solve task and algebra is correct for every revision.
Rows and columns match products, unfilled cells are truly blank with increased height; no underline clutter.
Unknown is not stated, equation is not shown, counts make sense, instructions specify what quantity to find.
Students must distribute/collect; level changes are mathematical; avoid coefficient cancellation unless classification target.
Non-routine transfer or counterexample, not merely a higher power/larger coefficient.

deliverable_policy: CATALOG_ONLY; no CPM bank modifications, no assessment plan modifications, no teacher review reset.
